profile.perfume: Chanel Allure Homme Édition Blanche Eau de Parfum
profile.baseline_state: COMPUTATIONAL CANDIDATE / ZERO EMPIRICAL SIMILARITY PASS
profile.official_summary: Powerful lemon meets New Caledonian sandalwood, Haitian vetiver and Madagascar vanilla in a hot-cold alchemy.
profile.target_identity: A cold, forceful lemon flash flowing into warm sandalwood cream, dry vetiver and restrained vanilla.
profile.hedonic_tension: Bitter cold brightness versus warm creamy depth.
profile.authority_note: Named origins are identity constraints; they are not interchangeable with generic oils.

art_direction.primary_motif: A blade of cold bitter lemon cutting through warm sandalwood cream.
art_direction.secondary_motif: A dry Haitian-style vetiver seam and restrained Madagascar-style vanilla glow.
art_direction.foreground: Lemon zest, bitter peel, cold aldehydic air and luminous sandalwood.
art_direction.background: Vanilla warmth, dry vetiver, floral air, white musk and incense dust.
art_direction.tension: Cold acidic brightness versus warm creamy depth.
art_direction.release: The cold lemon does not disappear; it becomes a pale bitter line running through the warm woods.
art_direction.negative_space: Ozonic air, muguet transmission and vetiver dryness prevent the sandalwood/vanilla block from becoming custard.
art_direction.recurrence: A lemon rind echo reappears at two hours when vetiver exposes the citrus bitterness inside the cream.
art_direction.texture_progression: frosted lemon peel → mineral air → dry vetiver thread → sandalwood milk → vanilla skin
art_direction.spatial_identity: Cold brightness projects; warm sandalwood and vanilla stay closer and bloom with body heat.
art_direction.late_residue: Creamy fibrous sandalwood, dry vetiver, pale vanilla, incense and soft musk.
art_direction.controlled_imperfection: A pithy bitterness and a thread of root dryness keep the white cream from becoming edible.
art_direction.hedonic_hypothesis: The attraction is thermal contradiction: a perfume that feels chilled and glowing at the same time.
layers: Lemon FCF, Lemonile, bergamot, citral, lime and aldehydes create cold force.
Petitgrain, neroli, galbanum, coriander and leafy traces connect citrus to the heart.
Hedione, muguet, magnolia, jasmine and ylang make the cream luminous rather than opaque.
Natural vetiver, Vetival, Vertofix, cedar and moss create dryness through the warmth.
Sandalore, Polysantol, Ebanol, Javanol, natural sandalwood and Cabreuva make multi-grain cream.
Vanilla, tonka, heliotrope, benzoin and differentiated musks produce warm skin residue.
hedonic_tuning: Lemon is overbuilt across several volatility bands so the opening has body, not only a top flash.
Sandalwood uses multiple geometries to avoid a one-molecule buttery monolith.
Vetiver is a seam, not a base note blob.
Vanilla is restrained and balsam-supported, keeping sweetness below pastry territory.

missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: Synthetic sandalwoods and an unspecified 10% sandalwood oil cover cream, radiance and wood, but not the origin-specific natural profile named by Chanel.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: The warm half may be creamy but less fibrous, natural and identity-faithful.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Buttery takeover, dusty wood or suppression of lemon and vetiver.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Current distributed sandalwood block versus exact natural lot at equal woody registration; include lemon-retention and 8 h residue endpoints.
missing_chemical_impact.owned_functional_coverage: Sandalore, Ebanol, Javanol 20%, Sandalwood Base X3, Sandalwood EO 10% DPG
missing_chemical_impact.purchase_or_prepare: High value only after a natural-lot screen confirms nonredundancy.

missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: Generic Vetiver EO and Vetival provide dryness and root, but do not establish the named origin profile.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: Less exact dry-green cut through the sandalwood/vanilla warmth.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Root mud, smoke or sour earth.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Generic vetiver versus Haitian lot in a fixed lemon-sandalwood-vanilla chassis.
missing_chemical_impact.purchase_or_prepare: Acquire only if exact-origin fidelity is prioritized.

missing_chemical_impact.candidate: Documented Madagascar vanilla raw or extract
missing_chemical_impact.why_not_redundant: Vanillin and generic vanilla/tonka warmth cover sweetness but not the named natural extract's full balsamic, woody and phenolic texture.
missing_chemical_impact.loss_if_omitted: Warmth may read laboratory-clean, candle-like or one-dimensional.
missing_chemical_impact.overdose_failure: Lemon pie, frosting or candle wax.
missing_chemical_impact.exact_comparison: Vanillin-only, tonka-supported and exact-natural vanilla routes at equal sweetness intensity.
missing_chemical_impact.owned_functional_coverage: Vanillin 10%, Ethyl Vanillin 10%, Tonka materials, benzoin
missing_chemical_impact.purchase_or_prepare: Useful specialist, not an automatic purchase.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Aldehydic/ozonic air stretches lemon into a frosted beam.
Petitgrain/neroli/green traces preserve pith and stop lemon-candy simplification.
Cold air over warm cream creates the defining hot/cold counterpoint.
interaction_map.physical_test: Full versus no-cold-air and no-cream controls.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Vetiver cuts the cream into fibrous warm wood.
Vanilla warms fibers without becoming dessert.
The pair can configure as elegant contrast or collapse into lemon pie.
Floral air makes dense sandalwood luminous and spacious.
interaction_map.physical_test: Floral-air block omission at 30 min and 2 h.

interaction_map.expected_effect: Musks carry warm vanilla as skin rather than candle wax.
A pithy mineral echo should recur through incense and vetiver.
interaction_map.failure_mode: Dead creamy base with no lemon memory.

test_plan.primary_comparison: Full Lemon White Heat versus no-cold-air, no-vetiver-seam, low/high vanilla, and exact-origin natural comparators.
pass_criteria: cold lemon and warm cream are simultaneous
positive liking and second-smell desire on two days
distinct from AHS and Eau Extrême
test_plan.reference_gate: Current EDP reference plus exact-origin natural lots for full target-fidelity.

temporal_test.replication: Two non-consecutive days; matched application geometry
temporal_test.core_time_question: Does lemon transform into warm cream without becoming lemon pie or disappearing abruptly?
temporal_test.instrumental_lane: HS-SPME-GC-MS at 0/30 min/2 h/8 h on sealed vial and blotter; static and dynamic data remain separate
temporal_test.sensory_lane: Coded descriptive time-intensity plus hard-defect checklist
temporal_test.thermodynamic_inputs: Exact stock amounts, ethanol/water matrix, temperature, substrate, dose area, vapor pressure, activity-coefficient model/version
